info.title: com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3
info.description:
## com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3.SandboxContext

Context for interacting with a container's runtime environment.

post.description: Close IO for a given process.
Configure DNS resolver.
Configure /etc/hosts.
Get statistics for containers.
Create a new process inside the container.
Delete an existing process inside the container.
Perform a filesystem operation on a mounted filesystem.
Get an environment variable from the init process.
Add an IPv4 address to a network interface.
Set the link state of a network interface.
Add an IP route for a network interface.
Add an IP route for a network interface.
Send a signal to a process via the PID.
Send a signal to the provided process.
Create a new directory inside the sandbox.
Mount a filesystem.
Proxy a vsock port to a unix domain socket in the guest, or vice versa.

Resize the tty of a given process. This will error if the process does
 not have a pty allocated.
Set time in the guest.
Set an environment variable on the init process.
Set up an emulator in the guest for a specific binary format.
Start the provided process.
Stat a path in the guest filesystem.
Stop a vsock proxy to a unix domain socket.
Perform the sync syscall.
Set sysctls in the context of the sandbox.
Unmount a filesystem.
Wait for a process to exit and return the exit code.
Write data to an existing or new file.

path.title: path
path.description: Path in the guest (destination for COPY_IN, source for COPY_OUT).

mode.title: mode
mode.description: File mode for single-file COPY_IN (defaults to 0644 if not set).

createParents.title: create_parents
createParents.description: Create parent directories if they don't exist.

vsockPort.title: vsock_port
vsockPort.description: Vsock port the host is listening on for data transfer.

isArchive.title: is_archive
isArchive.description: For COPY_IN: indicates the data arriving on vsock is a tar+gzip archive.

isArchive.title: is_archive
isArchive.description: For COPY_OUT METADATA: indicates the data on vsock will be a tar+gzip archive.

totalSize.title: total_size
totalSize.description: For COPY_OUT METADATA: total size in bytes (0 if unknown, e.g. for archives).

low.title: low
low.description: Number of times the cgroup was reclaimed due to low memory.

high.title: high
high.description: Number of times the cgroup exceeded its high memory limit.

max.title: max
max.description: Number of times the cgroup hit its max memory limit.

oom.title: oom
oom.description: Number of times the cgroup triggered OOM.

oomKill.title: oom_kill
oomKill.description: Number of processes killed by OOM killer.

oomGroupKill.title: oom_group_kill
oomGroupKill.description: Number of times charge for memory failed because of limit.

com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3.Me.title: MemoryEventStats
com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3.Me.description: Memory event counters from cgroup2's memory.events file.

dev.title: dev
dev.description: st_dev:     ID of device containing file

blksize.title: blksize
blksize.description: st_blksize: preferred block size for filesystem I/O

ctime.title: ctime
ctime.description: st_ctim: time of last status change

com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3.St.title: StatCategory
com.apple.containerization.sandbox.v3.St.description: Categories of statistics that can be requested.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.
